newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street shares tipped to open mixed to steady.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street shares tipped to open mixed to steady.

text.p: Wall Street shares are expected to open mixed to steady on Monday, somewhat cautious at the start of a week replete with U.S. economic data, analysts said.

While no key statistics are due on Monday, stocks and bonds should move carefully in anticipation of upcoming reports, including Tuesday's second-quarter employment cost index and Friday's employment data, they said.
Technology stocks are expected to be particularly active following reports on the personal computer market and news of an acquisition by chipmaker Intel Corp.
